Recorded: **R1 accepted by user decision, 2026-11-14 ~23:30Z**. It is now the formal baseline. Two follow-ups are logged, neither a blocker: (1) the contract and dependency gates were not independently re-run before acceptance; (2) PaletteTransport.lean is used but missing from frozen-manifest.json. The new consumer depends on it too, since `sixty` is declared at PaletteTransport.lean:390.

StepBanConsumer (job 232057-0) is banked as PASSED. EvenWalk is CLOSED via rev6, compiled locally at the desk (exit 0, 63 s, standard axioms). I will not requeue it, and the rev5 failure stays on record as superseded. I am telling the verification lane to stop all EvenWalk work: no split file and no m5/m6 rev5 diff. That frees all six of its members for the A5 sliver certificate. The architecture lane now gets the go-ahead for the owned-copy swap.

I made no Lean proposals this cycle. No new reviewed inbox .lean source exists yet: the WITH_G3 glued bridge is still being assembled by the formal lane, and no 6-member swarm has submitted Lean. Both slots will be filled as soon as reviewed sources arrive.

All 8 lanes have running 6-member swarms, so no successors are needed. Lanes I am not messaging this cycle are healthy and were left alone. There is still no global chromatic claim.
summary:
R1 accepted by user decision, 2026-11-14 ~23:30Z: 27 frozen modules plus the root axiom check pass locally and form the formal baseline. Follow-ups, not blockers: contract and dependency gates were not independently re-run; PaletteTransport.lean is used but absent from frozen-manifest.json.

Newly banked Lean (local, standard axioms only):
- five_support_step_ban_v2 and five_opposite_contacts_false_from_v2 (job 232057-0, 58.6 s).
- evenWalk_reachable, finite_list_obstruction and two_list_obstruction_of_even_walk (EvenWalk rev6, compiled locally at the desk, exit 0, 63 s). Rev6 is rev5 plus one `show` line before `rw [he]`. Rev5 job 232057-1 failed and is superseded; it will not be requeued.

Still open:
- A5 sliver certificate over all three pieces.
- WITH_G3 glued bridge: the source is still being assembled.
- StepBan swap into the CyclicCore consumer (owned copy only).
- Staircase classification, k=6 producer audit, and the geometry palette-inclusion question.

A8 remains unbanked. No global chromatic improvement has been proved. Paper proofs, exact computation and Lean validation are kept separate.
